verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical rescales. The teal circle is pulled fully into the frame and sits behind the logo and the can, which muddies the GLACIER wordmark. The legal line sits on the light-blue circle, and the grey fine print is very small and low-contrast. A keeps the legal line near the bottom edge like the original and leaves more room above the headline. B lifts the headline/CTA cluster up, leaving a dead band of empty space at the bottom with the fine print floating in the middle of the circle, so B's vertical balance is slightly worse.
